name: jira
description: Updates to the Jira Cloud issues you are assigned to, reported or watch (new comments, status and field changes), read through Jira's own API with an Atlassian API token. Read-only: it only ever asks Jira to show things and never changes an issue.

requires.help: Create an API token at https://id.atlassian.com/manage-profile/security/api-tokens and save a file there that looks like { "site": "https://yourname.atlassian.net", "email": "you@example.com", "apiToken": "..." }. Steps, and how to use a token that can only read: extractors/jira/README.md. This is almost always a work account: your employer's rules decide whether you may do this at all.
